summary: Deterministic Quick Dev identity projections for plan toolchain-workflow-repair; slices W0-W6; excludes logs/* and plan/resume state files; validates repository-relative non-traversal, non-symlink paths confined to root; contract must match plan ID and provide slices; candidate manifest flattens allowed/planned paths, drops wildcards, normalizes tools paths, records present SHA-256 or absent, deduplicates and sorts; dependency identities use current candidate hashes; per-slice identity hashes candidate, predicate, authority, validators, closure definition and validator file; snapshot aggregates all slice identities; fixed validator version toolchain-workflow-repair.validate-all.v1; authority and validator path sets are explicit.
